newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbeks have 1.4 mln T grain from 30 pct area sown.
newsitem.headline: Uzbeks have 1.4 mln T grain from 30 pct area sown.

text.p: Uzbekistan has gathered 1.385 million tonnes of grain from 30 percent of the total area sown, and both yields and harvesting tempos are higher than last year, an Agriculture Ministry official said on Tuesday.
"Grain harvesting is in full swing on all fields of the republic. The campaign is moving very well," Zair Latypov, deputy head of the ministry's grain department, told Reuters.
Latypov said farmers have so far harvested grain from an area of 447,000 hectares, the average yield being 3.31 tonnes per hectare.
He said in the same period last year the Central Asian state gathered 686,000 tonnes of grain from 267,000 hectares. Yields averaged 2.56 tonnes per hectare last year.

Authorities in the Central Asian state, with a population of 23 million, have said that the area sown to grain had fallen this year to a total of 1.49 million hectares from 1.69 million last year but said they expected higher yields.

Last year Uzbekistan's grain harvest totalled 3.54 million tonnes. Latypov said said that due to the faster rate of harvesting, this year's target of 4.0 million tonnes of grain was "obtainable". --Shamil Baigin, Tashkent Newsroom, +7 3712 361968
